summary: Micware Co., Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026 attaching its September 2026 investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) used at the Emerging Growth Conference and periodic investor roadshows. The Japanese company, listed on Nasdaq under MWC, filed nothing transaction-related; no stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer investor-relations update, not a special situation. Watch for any future capital-raising, strategic, or M&A announcements, but this filing alone presents no risk-arb opportunity.
